notes.title: The Hint Update comes to A Monster’s Expedition!
notes.content:
Starting today, A Monster’s Expedition now has a super-useful Hint feature! Enable it in the settings tab for hints for solutions to individual island puzzles, and even in-game tips for where to start looking for secrets.

A Monster’s Expedition is also now part of the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase, running from the 19th-23rd of May. Get the game on discount and explore the showcase to find your next favorite puzzle game, too!

https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CerebralPuzzleShowcase

notes.title: The Museum Expansion Update comes to A Monster's Expedition!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing [i]A Monster's Expedition[/i]! Today we've released the Museum Expansion Update, a major content addition with over 100 new puzzle islands and over a dozen new exhibits to discover. The new content is free as part of the 1.1.0 update, so please download and enjoy! Your save will work with this update, and you’ll pick the game back to where you left it, ready to explore the new uncharted areas.

Important note for macOS users:
As part of this update our minimum requirements have changed. Officially we support macOS 10.14 (Mojave) and above, which is unchanged from before. Previously we unofficially supported macOS 10.12 (Sierra) but support for 10.12 and earlier has been deprecated with the 1.1.0 content update as part of a necessary engine upgrade. For affected users, please follow these steps to continue playing version 1.0.4 of [i]A Monsters's Expedition[/i], compatible with macOS 10.12 (Sierra):
[list]
[*] Right click the name of the game in your Steam library
[*] Click "Properties"
[*] Click "Betas"
[*] Click "1.0.4 - Pre-content-update build"
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support of [i]A Monster's Expedition[/i].
